facts.activity_file: controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.title: hazard report - thermal exposure at K-7301

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on K-7301, M-7301 and PT-7301 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically controlling portable electrical equipment in zoned areas. K-7301 (vapour recovery compressor) is in service for loading vapour recovery. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 30 August 2013 a hazard report was recorded on K-7301, M-7301 and PT-7301 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
